# Segment 22 — cloud dashboard build summary

STATUS: build complete, automated verification passed.
Manual git/Streamlit-Cloud/secrets steps below — those need browser
interaction and are not auto-runnable.

## Files created

  src/snapshot_for_cloud.py             ~165 lines
    Bundle dashboard data + upload to R2. Append-only mirror with
    delete-stale-files behavior. Writes snapshot_manifest.json.

  src/data_source.py                    ~165 lines
    local↔cloud abstraction. Canonical R2_LAYOUT mapping (single
    source of truth — both this file and snapshot_for_cloud.py
    reference it). path_to() resolves repo-relative paths to either
    the local file (local mode) or a /tmp/-cached R2 fetch (cloud
    mode). cache_resource for the boto3 client; cache_data
    manifest-timestamp-keyed for invalidation on snapshot bump.

  src/dashboard_auth.py                 ~80 lines
    streamlit-authenticator==0.4.2 wrapper. Reads pre-hashed
    credentials from st.secrets, renders login + sidebar logout,
    st.stop()s on missing/invalid auth.

  src/hash_passwords.py                 ~70 lines
    Interactive password-hash generator. getpass for plaintext
    (no shell history, no screen). Outputs TOML snippet ready to
    paste into Streamlit Cloud secrets, plus a fresh random
    cookie key.

  requirements.txt                      ~30 lines (replaced)
    Pinned versions for both local dev and Streamlit Cloud.
    streamlit==1.57.0, plotly==6.7.0, boto3==1.43.3,
    streamlit-authenticator==0.4.2, ... (full list in file)

  models/cache/streamlit_cloud_secrets_template.toml
    Template structure to paste into Streamlit Cloud's Secrets UI.
    Placeholders for users/cookie/r2 — real values go in cloud
    secrets, never in git.

  README.md                             ~100 lines
    Project overview, local dev setup, snapshot-refresh procedure,
    first-time deploy instructions, user-management procedure.

## Files modified

  src/dashboard_app.py
    + Streamlit-secrets-to-env-vars bridge at top (must precede
      data_source import)
    + import data_source; CLOUD_MODE = data_source.cloud_mode()
    + Helper functions for path resolution: _db_path(), _db_url(),
      _trials_jsonl_path(), _macro_parquet_path(), _model_meta_path(),
      _dashboard_result_path(label, filename) — all delegate to
      data_source.path_to()
    + 6 hardcoded constants (DB_PATH, DB_URL, MACRO_PARQUET, etc.)
      replaced with helper calls; cloud reads now route through R2
    + main() now calls dashboard_auth.gate() when CLOUD_MODE is True
      (local mode skips the gate)
    + get_result_for_config() shows friendly "switch config" message
      and st.stop()s in cloud mode when a custom trial isn't
      pre-saved (live-fallback disabled in cloud per architecture)
    + Cloud-mode caption under page title for orientation
    Net: ~+45 lines, behavior identical in local mode.

  .gitignore
    + Cache data files excluded (parquet/db/jsonl/json) — local-only,
      mirrored to R2
    + Documentation files in models/cache/ retained (*.md, *.txt,
      *.toml — the template-only TOML for secrets)
    + .streamlit/secrets.toml explicit ignore
    + .venv/, .idea/, *.egg-info/ added

## Files NOT touched (per scope-protection)

  backtest.py, backtest_config.py, optuna_runner.py, objective.py,

  dashboard.py, macro_signals.py, finnhub_insider_signals.py,

Estimate from plan was ~600 KB; actual is ~6.4 MB because Optuna's
SQLite file (3.5 MB) and the trials JSONL (2.5 MB) are larger than
guessed. Still well under R2 free-tier limits (10 GB storage).

## Verification — NOT automated (your manual steps)

These need browser interaction and your inputs. Walk through in order:

### 1. Local visual walkthrough (recommended sanity check)

   cd src
   ..\venv\Scripts\activate
   streamlit run dashboard_app.py

   Open the browser URL shown. Confirm all 5 tabs render with data:
   Overview, Optuna explorer, Macro state, Positions, Trades log.
   Sidebar config selector (Default / Best trial / Custom trial)
   should switch overview metrics correctly.

   Take screenshots of each tab if you want a record. Streamlit's
   auto-detected theme should look identical to your prior local
   sessions — no regressions expected since local mode behavior is
   unchanged.

### 2. Initialize git repo (if not already)

   cd <project root>
   git init
   git branch -M main

### 3. Generate password hashes for cloud users

   cd src
   python hash_passwords.py

   Enter usernames + plaintext passwords for each authorized user.
   Plaintext is read via getpass (no shell history, no screen).
   Script outputs a TOML block — copy it for step 6.

### 4. Commit and push to GitHub

   git add src/ requirements.txt README.md .gitignore
   git add models/cache/*.md models/cache/*.txt models/cache/*.toml
   git commit -m "segment 22: cloud dashboard, snapshot, auth"
   git remote add origin git@github.com:<your-username>/<repo>.git
   git push -u origin main

   .gitignore excludes .env, models/ data files, __pycache__/, venv/,
   .streamlit/secrets.toml. Verify nothing sensitive made it in:
       git log --stat -1 | grep -E "\.env|secrets\.toml|\.parquet|\.db|\.jsonl"
   should print nothing.

### 5. Connect Streamlit Community Cloud

   Visit https://share.streamlit.io
   Click "New app"
   Repository: <your-username>/<repo>
   Branch: main
   Main file path: src/dashboard_app.py
   Python version: 3.11 (or 3.12 — both work for our pins)
   Click "Deploy"

   First deploy will fail to load data because secrets aren't set yet.
   That's expected — proceed to step 6.

### 6. Paste secrets into Streamlit Cloud

   In the new app's settings → Secrets, paste:
     - The [auth.users.*] and [auth.cookie] blocks from step 3's
       hash_passwords.py output
     - An [r2] block with your actual Cloudflare R2 credentials:
         endpoint_url      = "https://<account-id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com"
         access_key_id     = "<R2 token access key>"
         secret_access_key = "<R2 token secret>"
         bucket_name       = "paper-trader-snapshots"
     - The [app] section with cloud_mode = true
   See models/cache/streamlit_cloud_secrets_template.toml for the
   complete shape.

   Streamlit Cloud auto-restarts the app after secrets save.

### 7. Verify the deployed dashboard

   Open the Streamlit Cloud URL.
   Login form should render. Log in with one of the accounts from
   step 3. All 5 tabs should load — data fetched from R2.

### 8. Share the URL with dad + brother

   Send them: the URL, their username, their password.
   They'll see the same dashboard you do.

## Updating the deployed dashboard later

   1. Make local code changes; verify with `streamlit run dashboard_app.py`
   2. Re-run training/Optuna/save-results if data changed
   3. cd src; python snapshot_for_cloud.py    # re-mirror data to R2
   4. git add ... && git commit -m "..." && git push
   Streamlit Cloud auto-redeploys on push. R2 manifest's new
   generated_at busts the dashboard's read-side cache.

## Adding/removing cloud users later

   1. cd src; python hash_passwords.py        # generates new TOML
   2. Paste updated [auth.users.*] block into Streamlit Cloud secrets
      (Streamlit reloads automatically)
   3. To invalidate all current sessions on a user removal: rotate
      [auth.cookie] key to a new 32-byte hex string.
